# Copilot instructions

- The full build specification of this repository is `CLAUDE.md` in the repository root. Read it before any change; it wins over other documents except the constitution's principles I and II.
- Project principles: `.specify/memory/constitution.md`.
- Current feature: `specs/001-pacs-comparator-check/spec.md` (Spec Kit). Use `/speckit-plan`, `/speckit-tasks`, `/speckit-implement` in that order.
- Never commit anything under `data/`, the dataset zip, `.env`, or real report text or pseudonyms (`PAC-…`, `STU-…`, `DOC-…`).
